title: Parallax Theater
description: An overhead view of an elaborate theatrical stage designed as a mechanical puzzle arena. The wooden stage features glowing teal grid lines, a large central circular mechanism, scattered papers, floating orbs, clocks, and red curtains framing a mountainous backdrop with a bridge and hanging lanterns.
